headerDisplay:
### My Tadiran setup
1. Enter the phone number registered with **My Tadiran**. For Israeli accounts, `+972` is pre-filled — just add the rest of the number. You may also paste `050...` or the full `+972...` number; the plugin normalizes it automatically.
2. **Save and restart Homebridge.** An SMS code will be sent.
3. Enter the SMS code below, then **save and restart again**.
4. Done — the login refresh token is kept in Homebridge's persistent storage, so updates normally do not require another SMS.
footerDisplay: Unofficial cloud integration. Not affiliated with Tadiran. This plugin is built on the foundational API research and Home Assistant integration work of **Raz Luvaton (@rluvaton)** — see the README and THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES for full credit.

phone.title: My Tadiran phone number
phone.description: For Israel, keep +972 and add the rest of the mobile number (for example +972501234567). You can also paste 0501234567 and the plugin will convert it automatically.

otp.title: SMS verification code
otp.description: Only needed when linking your account. A used code is removed when you reopen settings after a saved login is available.

pollInterval.title: Polling interval (seconds)
pollInterval.description: How often Homebridge checks the Tadiran cloud for updated AC state.

exposeDryMode.title: Expose Dry Mode switch
exposeDryMode.description: Adds a separate HomeKit switch for DRY mode. Off by default to keep the Home app clean.

exposeFanOnly.title: Expose Fan Only switch
exposeFanOnly.description: Adds a separate HomeKit switch for FAN-only mode. Off by default to keep the Home app clean.

exposeFanSpeedControl.title: Expose separate Fan Speed control
exposeFanSpeedControl.description: Adds a separate HomeKit Fan service with a speed slider for Low / Medium / Auto / High. Its power button mirrors the AC power. The normal Heater/Cooler fan-speed control remains available where Apple Home shows it.

debugLogs.title: Enable debug logs
debugLogs.description: Logs My Tadiran command send/acknowledgement and cloud confirmation details for troubleshooting. Authentication tokens, OTP codes, and full phone numbers are never intentionally logged.
